mapper.insert: INSERT INTO memory_store (tenant_id, scope, owner_ref, name, current_revision, status, creator_id, version) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{scope}, #{ownerRef}, #{name}, 0, 'ACTIVE', #{creatorId}, 0)
INSERT IGNORE INTO memory_store (tenant_id, scope, owner_ref, name, current_revision, status, creator_id, version) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{scope}, #{ownerRef}, #{name}, 0, 'ACTIVE', #{creatorId}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM memory_store WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM memory_store WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY scope, id
SELECT * FROM memory_store WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE memory_store SET status = 'ARCHIVED', version = version + 1, modifier_id = #{modifierId} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

UPDATE memory_store SET maintenance_lease_owner = #{owner}, maintenance_lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, maintenance_lease_dispatch_id = #{dispatchId} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND (maintenance_lease_until IS NULL OR maintenance_lease_until < #{now})
